episodes.title: Ep 5: Lori and Alex
episodes.description:
Long before missing children and murder headlines, Alex Cox and Lori Vallow were just brother and sister. Through new interviews with their family, host Nate Eaton explores the siblings’ upbringing, Lori’s early marriages and Alex’s fiercely protective role in her life.

 

But a troubling allegation from Alex’s ex-wife also raises questions about their bond and whether warning signs went unrecognized.

episodes.title: Ep 4: Feel the Fire
episodes.description:
A search of Chad Daybell’s property brings the months-long investigation to a devastating turning point. Nate Eaton and detectives recount the day that changed the case and stayed with them long after.

For Lori’s mother and sister Summer, the news flips their world upside down. In a recorded jailhouse call, Summer confronts Lori and demands answers from the sister she thought she knew.

episodes.title: Ep 3: Proof of Life
episodes.description:
With Lori Vallow in jail and no sign of the children, investigators search for the last proof that JJ and Tylee were alive. Recorded calls reveal Chad and Lori’s unsettling private world, while Tylee’s best friend shares memories of the teenager behind the headlines and the messages that don’t sound like her.

As detectives sift through thousands of text messages, videos, photos and emails, a pattern begins to emerge.

episodes.description: A promising first date. Troubling stories of an estranged wife. Then, silence.
